verdict.rationale: Luma publishes llms.txt files at both lumalabs.ai/llms.txt and docs.lumalabs.ai/llms.txt, and a probe confirmed the docs one returns HTTP 200. Appending .md to any docs URL returns a markdown version, and the current Agents API docs offer "Copy Markdown" and assistant-open links, giving agents several documented entry points. Missing for 10: the probed docs llms.txt indexes the legacy-banner documentation generation, and there is no evidence of an llms.txt for the current Luma Agents API docs or any independent account of agents actually using these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
